title: Compose and operate the accepted IFX 0.4.2 bundle
goal: Create and verify a new receipted sibling installation from the C6d-accepted IFX 0.4.2 bundle, complete installed Web UI clean and deliberate-violation practice, prove root invariance, and stop before P10.2 or P10.3.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact 1.1.4 base, C6d production review, 0.4.2 manifest and C6c target identities are validated before any external output is created.
A new production sibling installation and external composition receipt pass the public composition verifier without modifying an existing release.
Installed Web UI direct Pre passes on the frozen clean target and visibly blocks the frozen IMPORT-DIRECTION violation with non-vacuous coverage.
UI verdicts, runs, findings, coverage and package identity match installed Host queries and retained evidence.
All authority and target inventories are unchanged after practice, and writes are confined to the new StateRoot and EvidenceRoot.
The final decision stops before P10.2 parity, P10.3 activation, remote publication, V3 retirement or IFX cutover.
risks: A reused external path could overwrite or confuse earlier installation evidence.
A browser verdict could diverge from the installed Host result or conceal a blocking failure.
Post-C6c governance commits must not be mistaken for the frozen certified Target commit.
C6e completion could be misrepresented as P10.2 parity or P10.3 activation.
decisions: Use a new sibling installation and external receipt; never modify the 1.1.4 base in place.
Export the exact C6c target commit into independent clean and deliberate-violation fixtures for installed UI practice.
Use direct Pre for bounded installed operator practice and stop before P10.2 or P10.3.
